title: BernsteinChainRunFacet
description: Custom OpenLineage run facet binding an exported event to the Bernstein lineage WAL chain (issue #4914).

chain_head_hash.description: WAL entry_hash at the lineage record position this event projects.

lineage_record_id.description: Stable id for the lineage record (WAL entry_hash).

signature.description: Detached sha256: digest of the event with this signature field blanked.

customer_signature.description: Optional customer Ed25519 signature from the lineage record.
